analysis.summary: During the Q3 and 9M FY26 earnings conference call, OCCL Limited management reported total income of INR114.6 crores and an EBITDA of INR20.2 crores for Q3 FY26, representing a 19% and 25% year-on-year growth respectively. Management noted that while automobile sales and the Indian tyre industry experienced supportive conditions-with the tyre industry expected to grow by 7% to 8% in FY26-profitability was severely constrained by all-time high sulphur prices that negated the benefits of anti-dumping duties. Additionally, export markets faced headwinds due to US tariffs which forced deep discounting, though management remains focused on capturing domestic market share and anticipates potential normalization of raw material costs or competitive price hikes over time. demand_outlook.quote: Approximate demand should be somewhere around 2.75 lakh to 3 lakh tons.

capex_expansion.claim: Maintenance capex stood at Rs. 7 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: This Rs.7 crore was maintenance CAPEX?

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q3 FY '26 stood at INR20.2 crores with EBITDA margins at 17.6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for Q3 FY '26 stood at INR20.2 crores, as compared to INR16 crores in Q3 FY '25, a growth of 25% year-on-year. EBITDA margins stood at 17.6%.

margins_costs.claim: All-time high prices of sulphur are affecting company margins.
margins_costs.quote: Though all-time high prices of Sulphur are affecting our margins, we expect either the Sulphur prices to come down or our competition and us to pass on these increasing raw material prices to our customers.

margins_costs.claim: The average price for sulphur in Q3 was about INR29 while the current price is about INR52.
margins_costs.quote: You are right. The average price for Q3 was about INR29. Current price is about INR52.

margins_costs.claim: When US tariffs went from 0% to 50%, the company had to give discounts in the American market in the range of 25% to maintain the same price.
margins_costs.quote: So see, when the tariffs have gone from 0% to 50%, so you can very well imagine to maintain the same price, we have had to give discounts in the American market in the range of 25%.

margins_costs.claim: The annual impact of the anti-dumping duty estimated earlier was in the range of INR11 to INR14 crores per annum and has been negated by the increase in sulphur prices.
margins_costs.quote: See, the impact -- annual impact of the duty that we had estimated earlier was in the range of INR12 to 14 crores or INR11-INR14 crores per annum. And this has been now negated by the increase in the sulphur prices.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that high sulphur prices impacting margins remain a challenge.
margins_costs.quote: Though high sulphur prices which impacts margin remain a challenge.

margins_costs.claim: Over the past few months, benchmark sulphur costs have seen a steady uptrend, driven by tight supply and stronger demand, putting pressure on input costs across the industry.
margins_costs.quote: Over the past few months, benchmark sulphur costs have seen a steady uptrend, driven by tight supply and stronger demand, putting pressure on input costs across the industry.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q2 FY26 stood at Rs.20 crores, against Rs.19 crores in Q2 FY25, a 5% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for Q2 FY26 stood at Rs.20 crores, against Rs.19 crores in Q2 FY25, a 5% year-on-year growth.

margins_costs.claim: During the quarter, the sulphuric acid quantity has also come down because there was an annual shutdown which was taken during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: What has happened is that during the quarter, the sulphuric acid quantity has also come down because there was an annual shutdown which was taken during the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: On insoluble sulphur, the increase merely on account of cost of sulphur for quarter ended September 2025 versus quarter ended September 2024 is more than Rs. 10,000 per tonne.
margins_costs.quote: If you look at the increase in cost of sulphur, on insoluble sulphur, the increase merely on account of cost of sulphur for quarter ended September 2025 versus quarter ended September 2024 is more than Rs. 10,000 per tonne.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fact that the Chinese did not increase the price even though raw material prices increased took away the whole benefit of the anti-dumping duty.
risks_headwinds.quote: And coming to your second question, yes, you are absolutely right. The fact that the Chinese did not increase the price even though raw material prices have increased, have taken away the whole benefit of the anti-dumping duty.

risks_headwinds.claim: High sulphur prices impacting margins remain a challenge as stated by management.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though high sulphur prices which impacts margin remain a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: The recent move by the United States to impose a 50% tariff on imports from India has also impacted our margins to the effect of the quantity that we are supplying there.
risks_headwinds.quote: The recent move by the United States to impose a 50% tariff on imports from India has also impacted our margins to the effect of the quantity that we are supplying there.

management_commitments.quote: So we are aggressively looking at increasing our share in the domestic market, and that strategy is going to get more focused in the coming year.

management_commitments.quote: So please allow us some time till June and we will come back and tell you whether we are seeing a market share increase.

management_commitments.claim: We are hopeful that this whole tariff situation should get resolved soon.
management_commitments.quote: Though we are hopeful that this whole tariff situation should get resolved soon.

management_commitments.quote: While we expect near-term realizations to stay soft as supply currently exceeds demand, we remain confident in our ability to navigate the short-term challenges.
